accounting_scope: Native campaign evidence, compact records, all Campaign002 workspaces, shared queue logs, Codex sessions and selected transcript/log database metadata; WSL full durable session10 backing. Identity-deduplicated logical bytes; per-identity positive growth above initial baseline, never offset by shrink/deletion. Shared-service growth conservatively included without attribution. No watched file contents read. Sampled temporal peak is a lower bound; actual volume free bytes independently preserve capacity. WSL VHD backing is not added to logical byte totals to avoid double counting; native free-space monitoring includes its real capacity impact. Namespace /tmp is tmpfs, not durable evidence. Planning allowance is advisory. Eight GB of observed new growth triggers review because Campaign001 ten attempts used under 0.5 GB; this is an anomaly signal, not a permission gate.
